messages:
Carla: Quick ask — PR #2147 (migration guide: private deployments) needs a docs reviewer. docs-preview CI failed with linkcheck. Can someone pick this up before the Friday release? <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2147|PR link>
Emma: I can take a look, assuming it’s not a huge rewrite.
Carla: Awesome, Emma. Mostly link fixes + one example tweak. The failing check is linkcheck and one code sample that changed arg names.
Emma: Got it. Pushing a small change now. The linkcheck errors: ```
ERROR: broken link /guides/private-deployments#networking -> 404
ERROR: external link https://old-templates.example.com -> 403
```
Lee: FYI we should add a quick note in the migration guide about the kwarg rename (`instance_type` -> `node_type`). Saves the next reviewer time.
Emma: Thanks — I'll update the example and swap that link to the canonical templates repo.
docs-bot: docs-preview started for PR #2147 — preview URL: <https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-2147|preview link> :gear: 
Morgan: Quick question on ownership — are we still following the weekly reviewer rotation or is this on-call? I can cover if Emma needs a hand.
Carla: We still use the rotation, but for docs emergency before a release it’s fair game. Emma, if you want a second pair just ping. Also: can we try to merge this in the Thurs merge window?
Emma: I’ll aim for Thursday. Will request review from @Lee for the kwarg note.
Lee: Happy to review once the example patch is up. If linkcheck is green I can do a quick skim.
Sanjay: Minor process ask — can we add a "docs:reviewer=Emma" label when assigning? Makes tracking in the release board easier.
Carla: Good call. I added the label. Also adding `merge-on-green` so CI gating is clear.
Emma: Patch pushed, retriggering preview: `/run docs-preview 2147`
docs-bot: docs-preview completed — linkcheck passed, preview available: <https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-2147|preview link> :white_check_mark: 
Lee: Reviewed and left one tiny nit about wording.
Emma: Fixed nit, updated changelog entry. Thanks!
Carla: Great — thanks Emma and Lee. Merging on green. Morgan/Sanjay — can we swap next week so rotation stays even?
Morgan: Yep I’ll swap with Emma for next week. :thumbsup: 
Sanjay: Thanks, all.
Emma: Merged and backported to main. Noted for rotation swap. :party:
